events.name: Endangered Bystanders
triggers: Earlier in this mission the team completed every listed objective
events.summary: Bystanders are put in peril. Each die buys 1d12 bystanders (or a flat 5), or lowers their stat tier by 1 from Tier IV (min Tier I). A bystander death usually causes exposure.
perDie: -1 bystander tier from base Tier IV (min Tier I)

events.name: Hazards
triggers: This scene: error on a Knowledge check to navigate a war zone or other dangerous area
This scene: error on a ranged attack
events.summary: A dangerous interruption: contagion, explosion, crossfire, runaway vehicle or security device. Effect by dice spent is in lookups.hazards (contagion alone can exceed 4 dice).

events.name: Marked for Death
triggers: This mission: target erred on a Computers/Access System, Investigation/Canvass Area, Networking/Contact, Streetwise/Black Market or Streetwise/Bribe check
events.summary: An assassin makes one attempt on a chosen character, following normal rules including morale. Assassin tier equals dice spent.

events.name: Mistaken Identity
triggers: This mission: target erred on any Cultures, Impress, Intimidate, Manipulate or Networking check
events.summary: A character is taken for someone else. Clearing it up is a Complex Impress/Persuasion Task: 1 Challenge + 1 per die (max 5); first DC 10 + Threat Level, +2 per later Challenge. After failure a retry needs both people present and DCs +5.

events.name: Nature's Fury
events.summary: Weather or natural disaster strikes: earthquake, fog, landslide, lightning, rain/snow, volcanic eruption or wind. Effect by dice spent is in lookups.naturesFury.

events.name: Responsibility
events.summary: The team is saddled with a Tier II NPC or a fragile item (Damage save bonus +10 or less). Dice buy duration or enemies; losing it usually causes exposure.
perDie: 1 Tier III NPC wants it killed, captured or destroyed (min 1)

events.name: Rival Approach
triggers: Previous mission: any character erred on a Profession/Accomplishment check
Previous mission: any character lost 2+ Reputation or $100,000+ Net Worth to exposure
events.summary: A special NPC (tier = dice spent) bribes the team to throw an objective (a one-use contact each) or to defect (+1 Reputation or +$50,000 Net Worth each per die). All must accept.

intensities.summary: Tier I NPC; acquaintance contact, or +1 Reputation/+$50,000
Tier II NPC; associate contact, or +2 Reputation/+$100,000
Tier III NPC; confederate contact, or +3 Reputation/+$150,000
Tier IV NPC; partner contact, or +4 Reputation/+$200,000

events.name: Shoddy/Worthless Item
triggers: This mission: the character erred while using the target item
events.summary: One item a character carries turns out flawed. 1-3 dice raise the error range of checks with it by 2 per die; 4 dice make it unusable. Cannot be sprung mid-use.

events.name: Surprise Chase
triggers: Previous or current scene: the characters let an opponent escape a chase or combat
events.summary: A chase starts while the group is moving. Each die adds 1 Tier II hunter (matching vehicle, 1d4 Tier I hired-gun passengers, weapons 1 Caliber below the vehicle) or raises all NPC tiers by 1.
perDie: +1 Tier to all NPCs in the chase

events.name: Surprise Combat
triggers: Previous or current scene: the characters let an opponent escape a chase or combat
events.summary: A fight starts while the group is stationary. Each die adds 1 Tier II soldier-for-hire leading 1d4 Tier I hired guns (armed to match the PCs, else unarmed fighters) or raises all NPC tiers by 1.
perDie: +1 Tier II soldier-for-hire with 1d4 Tier I hired guns (min 1)

events.name: Thief
triggers: Previous or current mission, after and outside the Intel Phase: the team acquired a Caliber III+ item or one costing over $50,000
events.summary: A Tier III thief with 3 Caliber II items goes after the team's valuables. Each die adds +1 Tier (max V), +1 item, or +1 Caliber to all the thief's items.

events.name: Under Review
triggers: Previous mission: the team willfully ignored a mission objective
Previous mission: the team brought home no more than 1/2 its gear picks (rounded down)
Previous mission: team members lost a combined 10+ Reputation or $500,000+ Net Worth to exposure
events.summary: Only at the start of the Intel Phase, not if already under review. Per die: max gear Caliber -1 (min II), -2 and +1 error range on Profession/Accomplishment. A Tier III observer tags along until the team completes consecutive objectives equal to dice spent.

intensities.summary: Max gear Caliber -1; Profession/Accomplishment -2, error +1; 1 consecutive objective to clear
Max gear Caliber -2; Profession/Accomplishment -4, error +2; 2 consecutive objectives to clear
Max gear Caliber -3; Profession/Accomplishment -6, error +3; 3 consecutive objectives to clear
Max gear Caliber -4; Profession/Accomplishment -8, error +4; 4 consecutive objectives to clear

events.name: Undesired Attention
triggers: This mission: team within 1 mile of a public explosion dealing 20+ damage, front-page news, or public tumult involving 100+ people
This mission: team members lost a combined 4+ Reputation or $200,000+ Net Worth to incident, noise or anonymity exposure
events.summary: A journalist or similar NPC threatens to expose the team. Complex Task: 1 Challenge + 1 per die (max 5); first DC 10 + Threat Level, +2 each after; skills must vary. Failure costs 3 Reputation or $150,000 per die and forces new names.

events.name: Wanted
triggers: This mission: the team commits any felony, noticed or not
events.summary: A Tier II detective runs a manhunt with Tier II officers (one per known team member). Each violent escape raises the next team a tier (III, IV, then V). Being sprung from custody costs 10 Reputation/$1,000,000, or 20/$2,000,000 if police were attacked.

securityNotes.title: Table 7.9: Security Options - footnotes and general rules
rows: PR = device Power Rating, chosen by the GC unless another rule sets it.
Skill checks to avoid a sensor carry the Armor Check Penalty tag.
Breaking this lock does not open the portal/container; it only prevents further skill checks to open it.
Check gains a Computers synergy bonus when a computer is used to forge the access item.
If a device is deliberately hidden, Detect DC = the hider's Stash Item (Scenery) result.
Sensor trips automatically unless disabled (e.g. pressure plate at 20+ lbs.).
Awareness bonus applies only to an automated eye; a remote human observer uses their own bonus.
Tripwire: Reflex save DC 10 + PR. Laser tripwire: Reflex save DC 15 + PR.
Attacks 1 character in its area each round until disabled or out of ammunition; ranged weapons hold PR × 5 shots unless stated.
PR multiplier doubles as range increment; error range 1, threat range = 1/2 PR rounded up (e.g. PR 5 = 18-20).
Rarely linked to locks or sensors; used to catch animals or people in the wild.
Victim is caged; cage Damage save bonus PR × 3, Security/Disable DC 10 + (PR × 2).
notes: XP for a device counts once per time the team must overcome it; identical duplicate devices on alternate entrances count once.
Devices are found with Notice/Awareness or Search/Perception vs. Detect DC and neutralized with Security/Disable vs. Disable DC.
A device that can be attacked has Defense equal to its Detect DC.

Traps with an attack bonus have error range 1 and threat range 20 and make a Standard Attack on whoever tripped the sensor; traps with a save DC deal 1/2 damage (rounded down) on a successful Reflex save.
Sensor Awareness checks are never subject to a result cap.

reputation.summary: Faction characters track Reputation, Freelance ones Net Worth (Hybrid: one or the other). Start at 2 or $100,000 at any level. Each completed mission pays the Caliber reward per character regardless of success (unless critical objectives apply), and a Profession/Accomplishment check can raise it. Spent on extra gear and favors; spending does not refresh. Lost through exposure. Below 0/$0 the character is burned: no mission gear or resources until back above 0. Below -20/-$1,000,000 he is also targeted for liquidation: each mission start the GC rolls 1d20, and on a result of 4 + 1 per consecutive targeted mission (counting the first) or less, a Marked for Death event hits him. GC may rescale Net Worth (e.g. 1/100 or 1/1,000).

anomalies.printed: Rows are keyed by "Action Die Cost" (1-4, contagion 1-8*), with no dice ranges
